👉 Want to learn how? Comment "AI" and join my upcoming course on AI for Interior Design and start finetuning details to creating stunning renders, faster and have a faster workflow in your interior design business.

Still can't believe how good this is 🤯
I gave ChatGPT an empty space + a moodboard…
and it filled the space based on the vibe, colors, and furniture I had in mind.

Honestly? It's such an inspiring way to kick off the ideation phase especially when you're stuck or need a visual starting point.

How I did it:
I uploaded my base image provided the moodboard as a reference and entered a detailed structured prompt.

For better accuracy, I also added individual images of key pieces like the sofa, chairs, and rug so the AI could really understand the vibe I was going for.

The result? Pretty mind-blowing.
